versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "打赏 Skill" for tipping/赞赏/送礼物 scenarios.
- Detects user intent for tipping and collects/validates the amount.
- Guides users through amount confirmation and cancellation.
- Supports constraints: amount must be >0 and ≤10000元.
- Integrates with payment skill to process and display payment results.
